scripts.clean:packages:
if exist packages\loop
ode_modules rmdir /s /q packages\loop
ode_modules && if exist packages\loop\dist rmdir /s /q packages\loop\dist && if exist packages\controllers
ode_modules rmdir /s /q packages\controllers
ode_modules && if exist packages\controllers\dist rmdir /s /q packages\controllers\dist && if exist packages\web-drivers
ode_modules rmdir /s /q packages\web-drivers
ode_modules && if exist packages\web-drivers\dist rmdir /s /q packages\web-drivers\dist
scripts.clean:apps: if exist apps\canvas\node_modules rmdir /s /q apps\canvas\node_modules && if exist apps\canvas\.vite rmdir /s /q apps\canvas\.vite && if exist dist rmdir /s /q dist
scripts.clean: pnpm run clean:packages && pnpm run clean:apps && pnpm run clean:root
scripts.nuke: pnpm run clean && pnpm install && pnpm run build:packages
